## Overview

The OpenAI o3 model, released on 2025-04-16, is a premium offering from OpenAI, providing a robust and feature-rich platform for developers. As a non-open-source model, it is designed to cater to complex and high-stakes applications, leveraging its capabilities in text, vision, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, OpenAI o3 is well-suited for tasks that require in-depth analysis and reasoning.

However, it is not recommended for simple tasks, high-volume applications, low-latency requirements, or budget-conscious projects.
